## Environment Doctor: which Python?

**Request:** "My import fails even though I added the package."

First, find out which Python is running.

```python
import sys
print(sys.executable)
```

Then check whether **that Python** can find the package.

::: {.source}
[Skill and diagnostic helper](examples/python-environment-doctor/SKILL.md) ·
[Python virtual environments][venv] · [Quarto Python selection][quarto]
:::

## Same computer, two environments

```{python}
#| echo: false
from IPython.display import Markdown, display

rows = ["| Environment | Module found | Import result |",
        "|---|---|---|"]
for label, result in environment.items():
    found = "Yes" if result["package_found"] else "No"
    outcome = "Success" if result["import_exit_code"] == 0 else "Fails"
    rows.append(f"| {label} | {found} | {outcome} |")
display(Markdown("\n".join(rows)))
```

**Diagnosis:** this teaching module exists only in A.

If A is the intended environment, run with A's interpreter.

::: {.small}
Computed from two temporary environments and a synthetic `demo_course`
module. No packages were downloaded. Your course environment is unchanged.
:::

## Project Handoff: where did I leave off?

**Request:** "Prepare a handoff so I can continue next week."

The skill checks the project files and Git history before writing a note.

<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Handoff section</th>
<th>What it answers</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>Goal and decisions</td>
<td>What are we trying to do?</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Evidence and status</td>
<td>What actually ran or was checked?</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Files and next action</td>
<td>Where should the next session start?</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

::: {.source}
[Skill and handoff template](examples/project-handoff/SKILL.md).
The demonstration uses a synthetic STAT 3255 final-project folder.
:::

## It worked last week. Does it still work?

```{python}
#| echo: false
print("Previous version output:", handoff["previous_output"])
print("Current source matches that version:", handoff["same_source"])
print("Current source executed by this check:",
      handoff["current_executed_by_this_runner"])
```

**Handoff:** the source changed after the recorded version.
The current result still needs checking.

**Next action:** inspect the change, then run the current analysis.

::: {.small}
The fixture runner executes the previous version and compares source hashes.
It deliberately leaves the current version unexecuted.
:::
